label: Body
description: A persistent direct-modeling solid with stable topology identifiers and mathematical circular-arc curves referenced by half-edges.

label: Wall
description: A wall segment that bounds space and hosts openings and wall-mounted elements.

label: Window
description: A parametric opening element hosted by a wall or roof segment.

label: pushPullBodyFace
description: Extrudes or recesses an existing Body face by a signed distance in metres.

label: Window hosted by Wall
description: A window placed in a wall must resolve an existing host wall before a modeling operation is applied.

label: Space
description: A bounded architectural region whose boundary and openings can be queried.

label: MEP terminal
description: A terminal feature whose run or equipment relationship must be evidenced before editing.

label: Deterministic modeling operation contract
description: A modeling operation exposes a typed preview, one commit, affected ids, and one undo step.

label: Ontology version pinned
description: Classification and validation evidence is interpreted against the requested Pack version.
